(2) Correct the bill_document_audit and handoff_brief.unresolved_concerns — the transcript shows the bill photo WAS sent and reviewed by the rep on the call (customer: 'Okay. It's in stock' at 05:57; rep: 'Oh, yeah. That's perfect' at 06:11, followed immediately by scheduling). Change bill_document_audit.result from 'promised_later' to 'received_on_call' (or equivalent) and remove/revise the handoff_brief claim that the photo 'had not been received by the end of the call' — this materially affects how complete/fragile the booking is read to be. (3) Remove or reclassify the 'enthusiasm_signal' cherry-pick at 00:58 — it duplicates the bill_anchor finding at 00:51 and misapplies the customer_demographics schema section; if kept, fold it into the bill_anchor_audit instead of listing as a separate cherry-pick. Optionally tighten the outcome_dispute language to reference the actual v1 tag rather than arguing against an unstated hypothetical, and consider adding the two missed positive moments (Brighton/Denver rapport aside at 00:29, and the flexible now-vs-callback offer at 04:48) for balance, though these are not blocking.
